news.title: Kings' Fiala happy to put leg injury behind him, has assist in season debut
news.ruTitle: Фиала из «Кингз» рад оставить травму ноги позади и сделал результативную передачу в дебютном сезоне
news.description: Kings forward Kevin Fiala, back for the first time since breaking his left leg at Olympics, had an assist in his season debut Thursday night against the Islanders

news.title: Schenn helps Islanders beat Kings 5-2 to end winless streak at 4
news.ruTitle: Шенн помог «Айлендерс» обыграть «Кингз» со счетом 5:2 и завершить безвыигрышную серию со счетом 4
news.description: — Brayden Schenn had a goal and two assists, Victor Eklund scored for the fourth straight game, and the New York Islanders snapped a four-game losing streak with a 5-2 victory over the Los Angeles Kings on Thursday night.

news.title: McMichael scores in 8th round of shootout as Blues outlast Mammoth 1-0
news.ruTitle: Макмайкл забивает в 8-м раунде серии пенальти, а «Блюз» побеждают «Мамонта» со счетом 1–0.
news.description: — Connor McMichael beat Karel Vejmelka with a snap shot to the top left corner in the eighth round of a shootout to give the St. Louis Blues a 1-0 victory over the Utah Mammoth on Thursday night.

news.title: Blackhawks beat the Sabres 3-2 in overtime to end 6-game losing streak
news.ruTitle: «Блэкхокс» обыграли «Сэйбрз» со счетом 3:2 в овертайме и завершили серию поражений из 6 игр
news.description: — Ryan Donato scored on a wrist shot from between the circles at 3:12 of overtime and the Chicago Blackhawks beat the Buffalo Sabres 3-2 on Thursday night to end a six-game losing streak.

news.title: Mark Scheifele and Dawson Mercer score 2 goals each as Jets roar past Stars 8-3
news.ruTitle: Марк Шайфеле и Доусон Мерсер забивают по 2 гола, когда «Джетс» обыгрывают «Старз» со счетом 8–3.
news.description: — Mark Scheifele had two goals and an assist, and Dawson Mercer had his second consecutive two-goal game as the Winnipeg Jets rode a five-goal second period and scored the final six goals to rally past the Dallas Stars 8-3 on Thursday night.

news.title: Avs lose MacKinnon, Makar to injury in 4-3 overtime loss at Ottawa
news.ruTitle: «Авс» проиграл Маккиннону и Макару из-за травмы в овертайме со счетом 4:3 в «Оттаве»
news.description: — Shane Pinto celebrated his 26th birthday by scoring his second goal of the game 2:08 into overtime and the Ottawa Senators beat Colorado 4-3 on Thursday night after the Avalanche lost superstars Nathan MacKinnon and Cale Makar to injuries.

news.title: Most consecutive games played in MLB, NFL, NBA, NHL
news.ruTitle: Наибольшее количество игр подряд, сыгранных в MLB, НФЛ, НБА, НХЛ.
news.description: Brent Burns has 1,000+ consecutive games played. Find out who else has played the most games in a row across other major leagues.

news.title: Panthers erase 4-1 deficit, top Red Wingst 5-4 behind 2 goals from Lundell
news.ruTitle: «Пантеры» нивелируют отставание со счетом 4–1, лучший «Ред Уингст» со счетом 5–4 после 2 голов Ланделла
news.description: — Anton Lundell scored his second goal of the night with 2:40 left to cap a rally from three goals down, and the Florida Panthers pulled off their biggest comeback of the season to beat the Detroit Red Wings 5-4 on Thursday night.

news.title: Canadiens snap Bruins' seven-game winning streak on home ice with 5-2 win
news.ruTitle: «Канадиенс» прервали семиматчевую победную серию «Брюинз» на домашнем льду со счетом 5–2.
news.description: — Josh Anderson and Jake Evans each had a goal and an assist as the Montreal Canadiens leapfrogged the Boston Bruins in the Atlantic Division standings with a 5-2 win on Thursday night.

news.title: Matt Boldy has 2nd hat trick of season to help Wild beat Maple Leafs, 5-2
news.ruTitle: Мэтт Болди сделал второй хет-трик в сезоне и помог Уайлд обыграть Мэйпл Лифс со счетом 5-2.
news.description: — Matt Boldy completed his second hat trick of the season and the sixth of his career early in the third period and the Minnesota Wild sent the Toronto Maple Leafs to a fifth straight regulation home loss with a 5-2 victory Thursday night.

news.title: Kolyachonok scores go-ahead goal, Hellebuyck makes 26 saves as Devils beat Capitals 5-2
news.ruTitle: Колячонок забивает гол, Хеллебак делает 26 сейвов, когда "Дьяволы" обыграли "Кэпиталз" со счетом 5-2
news.description: — Vladislav Kolyachonok scored the go-ahead goal early in the third period and Connor Hellebuyck made 26 saves as the New Jersey Devils beat the Washington Capitals 5-2 on Thursday night in the first of a two-game set.

news.title: Avalanche lose stars MacKinnon, Makar to 2nd-period injuries vs. Senators
news.ruTitle: «Лавина» теряет звезд Маккиннона и Макара из-за травм во втором периоде матча против «Сенаторов»
news.description: Avalanche forward Nathan MacKinnon and defenseman Cale Makar both left Thursday's game against the Senators after suffering lower-body injuries in the second period.
